GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 9 Lengths 3 Wide , Four Wide rounding turn, steered a couple of lanes past centre of track Straightening Up , Made Some Ground to the line # got a long way back

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 900m, tightened 500m, Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 4 Lengths 3 Wide , Held Up home turn then shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground down centre of track in Straight # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped and unbalanced on jumping. Was eased when tightened for room passing the 500m. Rounding the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shortly after straightening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down rear 6 Lengths Ridden Along x 500m, clear run home Outside Kept Coming , into 2nd and Closest on the line, # ran on well
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 6th 5 Lengths 800m 6th 7l home turn rails run 6th took split Middle Of Track 300m hit lead 200m ran away for an easy win # good ride/soft win

Jumped only fairly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, railed to 7.5 Lengths turning, Held Up rounding turn, Hooked Out Straightening Up before hooking back across behind heels from the 200m finishing on fence, Made Some Ground to the line # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels. Near the 150m was directed in around heels to continue to improve.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide (muddling pace), Drifted Back to 3 Lengths 3 Wide turning, eased down in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed cardiac arrhythmia (first time). Provisions of AR88B(2) invoked. Trial required.] # cardiac arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Carried wider approaching the home turn. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare, which commenced to weaken from the 500m and was eased down in the straight, revealed it to have cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. Since cleared to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down last 10 lengths. well back turn 8 lengths. hooked very Wide in Straight . ran on strongly # too far back
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, kept coming in Straight # ran on okay

Jumped only fairly Then eased across and Settled Down Mid Field with cover trailing 5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, pocketed biding its time around the turn, around heels Straightening Up and ran on hitting the Lead at the 100m, kept going to post # solid win
